subject: CONTRIBUTING.md
source:
python3 -c '
from pathlib import Path
text = Path("CONTRIBUTING.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
required = ["## Governance", "retornatus-gates", "npm run lint", "npm run build", "npm run test:coverage", ".retornatus/changes/"]
missing = [item for item in required if item not in text]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit("missing: " + ", ".join(missing))
print("CONTRIBUTING.md Governance section names Retornatus and retornatus-gates")
'
